# Similarity Analysis
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
data <- read_excel("Data.xlsx")
speciescount <- read_excel("species_inventory.xlsx")
# Map species Chinese names to English names
data <- merge(data,speciescount,by.x="Species",by.y = "Chinese_Name",all.x = TRUE)
data <- data %>% filter(Taxonomy %in% c("Bird","Mammal"))
dataF <- subset(data, Camera %in% c("F1","F2","F3","F4","F5","F6","F8","F9","FT10","FT11","FT12","FT13","FT14"))
dataQ <- subset(data, Camera %in% c("Q1","Q2","Q3","Q4","Q5","Q6","Q7","QT7","Q8","Q10","QT10"))

data_clean <- data %>% dplyr::select(Location, Camera, Common_Name, Taxonomy, Date, Number)

data_clean <- data_clean %>%
  # 1. Remove rows where Common_Name is feral dog or feral cat
  filter(!Common_Name %in% c("feral dog", "feral cat")) %>%
  
  # 2. Remove rows where Camera is one of the FT series listed
  filter(!Camera %in% c("FT10", "FT11", "FT12", "FT13", "FT14")) %>%
  
  # 3. Rename QT7 to Q7 and QT10 to Q10
  mutate(Camera = case_when(
    Camera == "QT7" ~ "Q7",
    Camera == "QT10" ~ "Q10",
    TRUE ~ Camera # Keep all other camera names the same
  )) %>%
  
  # 4. Rerank (sort) the dataframe by Camera
  arrange(Camera)

data_clean <- subset(data_clean, Taxonomy == "Mammal")

library(tidyverse)
community_matrix <- data_clean %>%
  # distinct() ensures we only count presence once per camera (0/1), not abundance
  distinct(Camera, Common_Name) %>% 
  mutate(Present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Common_Name, 
    values_from = Present, 
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  # Convert the 'Camera' column to Row Names (required for vegan package)
  column_to_rownames(var = "Camera")

metadata <- data_clean %>%
  distinct(Camera, Location) %>%
  # CRITICAL: Reorder metadata rows to match the community_matrix exactly
  slice(match(rownames(community_matrix), Camera)) %>%
  # Set row names to match the matrix for safety
  column_to_rownames(var = "Camera")

library(vegan)
dist_matrix <- vegdist(community_matrix, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

anosim_result <- anosim(dist_matrix, metadata$Location)

nmds_result <- metaMDS(dist_matrix, k = 2, trymax = 100)

# Extract scores for plotting with ggplot
nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_result, display = "sites"))
nmds_scores$Location <- metadata$Location
nmds_scores$Camera <- metadata$Camera

# Calculate Convex Hulls
hull_data <- nmds_scores %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  slice(chull(NMDS1, NMDS2))

zone_colors <- c(
  Fushan = "#D55E00",
  Qishan = "#0072B2")
# Plot
ggplot(nmds_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Location, fill = Location)) +
  # Draw the convex hulls
  geom_polygon(data = hull_data, alpha = 0.3) +
  # Draw the points (Cameras)
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  # Add text labels (optional, can be cluttered)
  # geom_text(aes(label = Camera), vjust = 1.5, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = zone_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = zone_colors)+
  labs(
    title = "NMDS of Species Composition by Zone",
    subtitle = paste("Stress:", round(nmds_result$stress, 3), 
                     "| ANOSIM R:", round(anosim_result$statistic, 3), 
                     "p =", anosim_result$signif),
    x = "NMDS 1",
    y = "NMDS 2"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill=NA, size=1)
  )

```

# Similarity Analysis II: only use periods when both Qishan and Fushan cameras were operating
```{r}
# ===============================================================================
# 1. Load required R packages
# ===============================================================================
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lubridate)
library(vegan)

# ===============================================================================
# 2. Read and process camera deployment history, extract overlapping working dates
# ===============================================================================
camera_info <- read_excel("Fuzhou_Camera_info.xlsx")

# Expand the wide table into a daily time series
camera_dates <- camera_info %>%
  dplyr::select(Location, Camera, starts_with("Install"), starts_with("Check")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with(c("Install", "Check")),
    names_to = c(".value", "Period_ID"),
    names_pattern = "(Install|Check)(\\d+)",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) %>%
  # Normalize character/Excel date formats to Date
  mutate(
    Install = ymd(Install),
    Check = ymd(Check)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Install) & !is.na(Check)) %>%
  # Expand each working period to a daily sequence
  mutate(Daily_Sequence = map2(Install, Check, ~seq(.x, .y, by = "day"))) %>%
  unnest(Daily_Sequence) %>%
  dplyr::select(Location, Camera, Daily_Sequence)

# Extract unique dates where cameras were operating for the two sites
fushan_dates <- camera_dates %>% filter(Location == "Fushan") %>% pull(Daily_Sequence) %>% unique()
qishan_dates <- camera_dates %>% filter(Location == "Qishan") %>% pull(Daily_Sequence) %>% unique()

# Intersection: dates when both Fushan and Qishan had cameras operating
# Note: intersect may coerce Date to numeric; use as.Date to restore Date class
overlap_dates <- as.Date(intersect(fushan_dates, qishan_dates), origin = "1970-01-01")

cat("Number of overlapping days when both sites were operating:", length(overlap_dates), "days\n")

# ===============================================================================
# 3. Read and clean species records, apply overlap_dates filter
# ===============================================================================
data <- read_excel("Data.xlsx")
speciescount <- read_excel("species_inventory.xlsx")

# Map species Chinese names to English names
data <- merge(data, speciescount, by.x="Species", by.y = "Chinese_Name", all.x = TRUE)

data_clean <- data %>% 
  dplyr::select(Location, Camera, Common_Name, Taxonomy, Date, Number) %>%
  filter(Taxonomy %in% c("Bird", "Mammal")) %>%
  
  # Apply standard cleaning rules
  filter(!Common_Name %in% c("feral dog", "feral cat", "bat", "rat", "shrew")) %>%
  filter(!Camera %in% c("FT10", "FT11", "FT12", "FT13", "FT14")) %>%
  mutate(Camera = case_when(
    Camera == "QT7" ~ "Q7",
    Camera == "QT10" ~ "Q10",
    TRUE ~ Camera
  )) %>%
  
  # Key step: convert Date format and keep only records within overlap_dates
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%
  filter(Date %in% overlap_dates) %>%
  
  # Filter target taxa (Example here uses Bird)
  filter(Taxonomy == "Bird") %>%
  arrange(Camera)

# ===============================================================================
# 4. Build community matrix and metadata
# ===============================================================================
community_matrix <- data_clean %>%
  # Ensure each camera-species pair is counted once (presence/absence)
  distinct(Camera, Common_Name) %>% 
  mutate(Present = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Common_Name, 
    values_from = Present, 
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Camera")

# If strict date filtering causes some cameras to have no records in the intersection,
# they will disappear from the matrix. This is the correct ecological handling (remove all-zero samples).
metadata <- data_clean %>%
  distinct(Camera, Location) %>%
  slice(match(rownames(community_matrix), Camera)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Camera")

# ===============================================================================
# 5. Community analysis: NMDS and ANOSIM
# ===============================================================================
# Compute Jaccard distance matrix (suitable for binary presence/absence)
dist_matrix <- vegdist(community_matrix, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

# ANOSIM analysis
anosim_result <- anosim(dist_matrix, metadata$Location)

# NMDS ordination
nmds_result <- metaMDS(dist_matrix, k = 2, trymax = 100)

# ===============================================================================
# 6. Data visualization (ggplot2)
# ===============================================================================
# Extract coordinates for plotting
nmds_scores <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_result, display = "sites"))
nmds_scores$Location <- metadata$Location
# Fix potential bug when extracting Camera names (use rownames of metadata)
nmds_scores$Camera <- rownames(metadata)

# Calculate convex hull boundaries
hull_data <- nmds_scores %>%
  group_by(Location) %>%
  slice(chull(NMDS1, NMDS2))

zone_colors <- c(
  Fushan = "#D55E00",
  Qishan = "#0072B2"
)

# Plot NMDS scatter
ggplot(nmds_scores, aes(x = NMDS1, y = NMDS2, color = Location, fill = Location)) +
  geom_polygon(data = hull_data, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  # To show camera labels, uncomment the line below
  # geom_text(aes(label = Camera), vjust = 1.5, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_color_manual(values = zone_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = zone_colors) +
  labs(
    title = "NMDS of Mammal Species Composition by Zone (Overlapping Dates Only)",
    subtitle = paste("Stress:", round(nmds_result$stress, 3), 
                     "| ANOSIM R:", round(anosim_result$statistic, 3), 
                     "p =", anosim_result$signif),
    x = "NMDS 1",
    y = "NMDS 2"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 1)
  )
```
